## New
- Linked devices: choose where a new group lives: a Flow sync server, a WebDAV folder such as Nextcloud, or this network only; a WebDAV folder is checked before anything is written (#1075)
- Linked devices: restore a group from a WebDAV folder, and enter a WebDAV login before scanning to pair through the folder from another network (#1075)
- Linked devices: when a WebDAV server refuses the login, sync stops and asks for it again (#1075)
